text: Computer Science and Technology is an interdisciplinary field that studies the design, development, application and theory of computers, integrating mathematics, engineering, logic and information technology. It not only covers the fundamental principles of computer hardware (such as processors and memory) and software (such as operating systems and algorithms), but also includes the development and application of cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence, big data and cloud computing. From the operating systems of smart phones to the control systems of spaceships, this major covers all fields of modern technology and is the core driving force of the digital age.
